title: Streaming success envelope (v1)
description: The single compact, LF-terminated JSON document a successful streamed answers run writes on stdout in buffered JSON mode. A streaming exchange has no single JSON body, so data.upstream is the ordered array of decoded stream events — this CLI's own lossless decoding of the SSE body — each entry carrying the event kind and its exact payload, bounded by the buffered-mode accumulation ceiling. data.projection carries the assembled answer and the citation and entity projections; meta.usage carries the usage observed in the final stream events at exact decimal scale; meta.warnings carries the jsonl-is-preferable advisory.

projection.$comment: The assembled streaming projection; pinned by answers-streaming.schema.json.

upstream.$comment: The ordered array of decoded stream events: one entry per event in decode order. An array whose elements carry event_index and kind is the discriminator of a streaming envelope; it never matches the multi-request upstream-entry form.
